title.narrative: Resettlement from Latin and Central America

description.narrative: Through this project, IOM provides transportation and other assistance to refugees from Latin and Central America for resettlement to the United States of America. These activities are part of the United States Refugee Admissions Program (USRAP) and fall under the memorandum of understanding between the State Department/Bureau of Population, Refugees, and Migration (BPRM) and IOM.
